text:
maria: heads up — PR #11800 is hitting intermittent failures on CI wave-3 (shard 5). First seen ~2h ago, two reruns later it's still flaking. Anyone able to take a look?

jake: saw that. kv_cache_test throws segfault inside mmap on linux-x86. can't reproduce locally with docker image. log snippet:
```
Assertion failed: kv_cache_test.cpp:142: commit_cache() crashed (sig 11)
Stack: 0x7f8e1a2b, 0x4009f2, 0x7f8e2b1c...
```

priya: can we do a targeted rerun on shard 5? /rebuild would requeue everything.

maria: prefer targeted rerun — pressure on quota. @sam can you kick just shard 5?

sam: sure. running: `ci-bot retry --pr 11800 --shard 5`

ci-bot: started retry for PR 11800: job ci/wave-3/shard-5 (build 4578)

ci-bot: retry complete — job finished with FAILURE (same segfault)

elena: hmm. stack points at mmap+thread race. maybe test expects timing. can we increase test timeout or add deterministic temp dir? link: https://internal/docs/flaky-tests

priya: if it's timing, maybe run with TSAN? that'll be slow but might catch use-after-free.

jake: I'll try reproducing with valgrind+TSAN on a larger VM. If I can get a deterministic repro I'll open a fix PR.

maria: thanks. if you have a small mitigation (guard or tweak) we can merge as short-term and add an issue to revert. Who can approve a small change quickly?

jake: I can review and approve. @elena can you sanity-check the test change before merge?

elena: yep, ping me when it's up. also let's add `flake: shard-5` label on the PR if it keeps failing.

maria: will do. if it flakes again after jake's attempt we'll mark flaky and land a revertable guard. thanks all :thumbsup:
